versions.changelog:
- Added multi-version support for ClickHouse 24.8, 23.3, and 22.3 with version-specific grammar and keywords.
- Introduced two check modes: syntax check (default) and MRS development specification check; "all" mode runs both.
- Implemented first-in-session prompt for required kernel version and check mode, with session-based reuse.
- Custom tokenizer and parser fully support ClickHouse-specific syntax and 47 statement types (DML/DDL/DCL/TCL/Utility).
- No cluster connection, authentication, or external dependencies; works entirely offline using Python standard library.
